title: A shopping list line
hints: `qty` is an int, and `^` only joins strings. Writing `item ^ ": " ^ qty` gives a type error. Read it: what does it say it expected?
Turn the number into a string first with `string_of_int qty`.
explain: `^` needs a string on both sides, and `qty` is an int. `string_of_int` converts it, so `item ^ ": " ^ string_of_int qty` type checks and gives `"eggs: 12"`.
